Subject: [PownceAPI] JavaScript Pownce Library


I've been working on a JavaScript lib which could be included on any
website, and access Pownce's API without the need of creating a
proxy.

There is a demo located

http://www.dinnermint.org/pownce/demo/

And the source can be downloaded from

http://code.google.com/p/pownceapi/source/browse

enjoy
